sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- Aditya Bhushan Singhal,Anjali Upadhya,C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The petitioners have assailed a notice dated 26.12.2023 issued by Sub Divisional Officer,
Jevar/Administrator, Rehabilitation and Resettlement, Noida International Airport, Jevar, Gautam Buddha Nagar, whereby the petitioners have been directed to remove the constructions allegedly being undertaken after issuance of notification under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation Sanjeev Kumar And 4 Others vs State Of U.P. And 8 Others on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99647074/
1 and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013; or to submit their reply to the notice, failing which it shall be presumed that petitioners have no defence and further action would be taken accordingly.
2. The specific case of the petitioners is that they had built their houses over the land in question in the year 2021 and thus, according to the petitioners they were not raising any new constructions.
3.

Learned Standing Counsel has placed on record the written instructions received from S.D.M Jevar, Gautam Buddha Nagar from which it transpires that so far notification under Section 19 of the Act has not been issued and therefore, the vesting has not taken place.

4. Having regard to the case of the petitioners that they were not raising any new constructions and in respect whereof they are stated to have filed their objections before Sub Divisional Officer, Jevar (respondent no. 6), we dispose of the instant petition by providing that respondent no. 6 will pass a speaking order taking into consideration the objection of the petitioners and until the order is passed, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioners in pursuance of the impugned notice.
At the same time the petitioners will also not raise any new constructions.

5. Sri Aditya Bhushan Singhal, learned counsel for respondent no. 3 and Ms. Anjali Upadhyay,
learned counsel for respondent no. 8 are present.
Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
